hero.name: Sooraj
hero.tagline: Final-year MCA student building robust web applications with Python, Django, REST APIs, and MySQL. Currently expanding full-stack capabilities with modern React & Tailwind CSS architectures.

about.bio:
I am a final-year Master of Computer Applications (MCA) student at APJ Abdul Kalam Technological University (KTU) in Kerala, maintaining a consistent 8.0 CGPA.

My engineering approach centers around structural clarity: designing clean relational schemas in MySQL, crafting modular, testable application logic in Django & Python, and writing clean REST APIs. My toolkit also includes practical experience in PHP, C, and C++, which provided a grounded understanding of memory management, algorithms, and core system concepts.

Rather than staying confined to backend templates, I am actively leveling up into modern full-stack development with React, Tailwind CSS, and JavaScript (ES6+), bridging solid server-side architectures with intuitive, responsive interfaces.

projects.name: LeavEase
projects.subtitle: Enterprise Leave & Absence Management Platform
projects.description: A comprehensive leave management system built with Django that eliminates paper trails with role-based access control, interactive department calendars, and real-time approval pipelines.
projects.fullDescription: LeavEase addresses workflow bottlenecks in academic institutions and corporate departments. Designed with strict RBAC, employees and faculty submit multi-day leave requests with mandatory medical certificate uploads (validated and securely stored). Department Heads and HR administrators review requests through interactive Chart.js analytics dashboards and synchronized FullCalendar.js schedule matrices.
highlights: Multi-tier RBAC for Employees, Department Heads, and SuperAdmins
Interactive department schedule synchronization with FullCalendar.js
Real-time leave balance computation, accrual tracking, and Chart.js metrics
Secure encrypted file handling for medical certificates and supporting docs
Automated email notification triggers upon request status state-changes

projects.name: ALAMARAi
projects.subtitle: AI-Powered Wardrobe & Fashion Intelligence
projects.signatureDetail: Google Gemini 1.5 Multimodal API Vision & Styling Engine
projects.description: An intelligent wardrobe companion leveraging the Gemini API to analyze garment images, categorize clothing, and generate weather- and occasion-aware outfit combinations.
projects.fullDescription: ALAMARAi bridges computer vision and daily lifestyle organization. Users upload photos of their clothing; Gemini Multimodal API processes visual cues (fabric, pattern, color palette, formality) to automatically catalogue items into a relational schema. The app generates custom outfit recommendations tailored to regional weather forecasts, formal dress codes, or casual outings.
highlights: Multimodal image classification using Google Gemini 1.5 Flash API
Context-aware outfit recommendation engine with temperature & event filters
Digital closet inventory management with color harmony evaluation
Responsive photo upload workflow with client-side image compression
Custom Django REST endpoints serving React frontend components

projects.name: SmartMart API
projects.subtitle: High-Throughput E-Commerce & Inventory Microservices
projects.signatureDetail: JWT Stateless Authentication & Redis Query Caching
projects.description: Stateless Django REST Framework microservice architecture supporting product catalogs, atomic checkout transactions, and inventory replenishment webhooks.
projects.fullDescription: Engineered to practice microservice resilience and relational optimization. Features parameterized database queries to eliminate N+1 bottlenecks, JWT authentication tokens with refresh rotation, and comprehensive Swagger/OpenAPI documentation.
highlights: Stateless JWT authentication with role permission classes
Database indexing and query optimization on product queries
Swagger UI / OpenAPI 3.0 schema generation with drf-spectacular
Atomic order transactions preventing inventory overselling

projects.name: MedVault Records
projects.subtitle: Clinical Record & Prescription Audit System
projects.signatureDetail: 3NF Normalized Schema with Strict Foreign Key Cascades
projects.description: A secure clinical registry designed with PHP and MySQL facilitating doctor consultations, digital prescription logs, and patient diagnostic histories.
projects.fullDescription: Developed during early MCA coursework to master core relational database theory, SQL stored procedures, and secure session management. Demonstrates fundamental understanding of database normalization, transaction isolation, and PHP server scripting.
highlights: Normalized relational schema in 3rd Normal Form with audit logs
Prepared statements and SQL injection prevention
Digital prescription PDF generation and printing interface
Doctor appointment scheduler with automated slot verification
